title: Why Cognition bought Poke: AI personality is becoming a competitive advantage | TechCrunch
summary: Poke plans to remain on Apple’s platform. However, next year the team will experiment with how both Poke and Devin can improve, with Poke turning to Cognition’s newest software engineering model SWE-1.7 for some tasks.
